name: mode
meaning: 0 = parked (fully in or fully out), 1 = sliding in, 2 = sliding out. Written only by Chronometer_SetMode (0x4ac471) and read by the Update switch.

name: bufToggle
meaning: Flipped 0/1 every drawn frame; selects unusedBufA or unusedBufB as ScnBody_RenderEx's second argument. Since that argument is never read by the callee, the toggle has no visible effect.

name: onScreen
meaning: 1 while the HUD clock is drawn. Set by SetMode(1) once Ralph answers 'not dead' and by msg 0x4703 with a non-zero argument; cleared when the slide-out finishes. Its gate at 0x4ac069 also skips ScnBody_AdvanceAnim, so the clock model's animation is frozen while parked.

name: panelColor
meaning: RGB currently used for the backing sprite (g_spriteCrayon2). Latched from panelColorTarget when the clock starts sliding in; a mismatch with the target forces a hide/show cycle so the colour only ever changes off screen.

name: panelColorTarget
meaning: RGB requested by the last ChronometerMsg: 0x5050dd for MSG_CHRONO_SHOW_DEPARTURE 0x4701 and 0xdd5050 for MSG_CHRONO_SHOW_ARRIVAL 0x4702 (ChronometerMsg.csv). Init value 0xdd5050.

name: slideOffset
meaning: Vertical HUD offset in pixels: 0 = fully in view, 0x20 = parked off screen (the Init value). Mode 1 subtracts 4 per frame down to 0, mode 2 adds 4 up to 0x20; every drawn element's y is 0xf0 + slideOffset minus a per-element constant.

name: unusedBufA
meaning: First of two 0x190-byte blocks whose address is handed to ScnBody_RenderEx 0x51166d as argument 2 and forwarded to Instance_DrawAnimatedOnScreen's [ebp+0x14]. Neither [ebp+0x14] nor [ebp+0x18] is referenced anywhere in 0x55d681-0x55d86a, so the block is dead storage.

name: unusedBufB
meaning: Second block, alternated with unusedBufA by bufToggle and equally dead. Its size is fixed by timeFixed starting at +0x398. Together they are 0x320 of the object's 0x4b4 bytes - most likely a PS1-era leftover.

name: timeFixed
meaning: The displayed time, in seconds with a 12-bit fraction (1.0 s = 0x1000). Tens digit = (t / 0xa000) % 10, units = (t >> 12) % 10 (a signed divide, not a raw shift), and the tick threshold uses t * 1000 >> 12 against 0x2710.

name: hudCam
meaning: A private camera used only to draw the clock model as a HUD element; 0xe0 bytes, exactly filling 0x39c..0x47b. Camera.csv's pos +0xd0, dist +0xd6 and rot +0xd8 map onto this+0x46c/+0x472/+0x474, and the two Mat44 members Create builds at this+0x3dc and +0x41c are its viewMat and viewMatCopy.

name: digitSprite
meaning: Digit sprite sheet, AnimSprite_InitFromRes(0x82). Its width/height at sprite +0x30/+0x32 (this+0x4ac/+0x4ae) size the two digit quads, drawn at x 0x41 and 0x53 on g_screenLayerBase+0x20 (layer 8); the backing sprite draws on +0x24 (layer 9).

name: alarmSoundHandle
meaning: Handle of sound 0xe4, started once during the slide-out when timeFixed has reached 0 and no copy is already playing - the time-up alarm.

name: tickSoundHandle
meaning: Handle of the looping tick, sound 0x3f, started by SetMode(1) and volume-ramped by the ChronometerMsg handler; stopped when the slide-out finishes. The ramp itself is broken - see the 0x398 note and the module write-up.
